page_title: RSO 3-1 CEL | Real Sociedad v Celta Vigo 25/01/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+6' 3 - 1 Goal! Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Ionut Radu into the bottom right corner.
90+5' Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) is going to take the penalty!
90+4' Referee Javier Alberola sees the trip by Ionut Radu (Celta Vigo) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle. Real Sociedad are awarded a penalty kick!
90+4' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) unleashes a shot, but his effort is poor and floats high over the bar.
90+3' Bryan Zaragoza (Celta Vigo) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
90+2' Marcos Alonso (Celta Vigo) hammers the ball from far out, but his shot is blocked by an opposition player. The referee points to the corner flag and Celta Vigo will take a corner.
90+1' Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) swings it in and Borja Iglesias gets on the end of it, but Alex Remiro shows good awareness and comes off his line to thwart the move.
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Real Sociedad quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

89' Orri Oskarsson (Real Sociedad) attempts to convert a lofted cross as he jumps high and heads the ball to the left side of the goal. Ionut Radu shows his brilliant reflexes and pulls off a glorious save to stop the ball from hitting the net. It will be a corner kick for Real Sociedad.
88' Jones El Abdellaoui (Celta Vigo) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
86' Pellegrino Matarazzo has decided to substitute Mikel Oyarzabal and he is replaced by Orri Oskarsson (Real Sociedad).
82' Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
81' The referee signals a substitution. Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) is brought on as a substitute for Luka Sucic.
81' Williot Swedberg (Celta Vigo) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
79' Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo) probably handled the ball.
76' Claudio Giraldez has decided to make a change. Williot Swedberg (Celta Vigo) replaces Sergio Carreira.
76' A substitution has been made. Hugo Sotelo is replaced by Miguel Roman (Celta Vigo).

75' 2 - 1 Goal! Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) weaves his way past opponents, and he unleashes a magnificent effort from the edge of the box into the bottom right corner. Ionut Radu had no chance of reaching it. The score is 2:1.
72' 1 - 1 Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo) receives a well-taken defence-splitting low pass inside the box and scores! His great effort makes its way into the middle of the goal.
72' Celta Vigo take a short corner kick.
70' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Pablo Marin (Real Sociedad) comes onto the pitch so that Goncalo Guedes can be given a rest.
69' Bryan Zaragoza (Celta Vigo) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom left corner, but Alex Remiro has it covered and makes a comfortable save.
68' Pellegrino Matarazzo is stunned as referee Javier Alberola shows him a yellow card. What was that for?
67' Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) sends a chip pass into the box, but Alex Remiro is quickest to intercept the ball.
64' The linesman raises his flag. Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo) is adjudged offside.

63' Jones El Abdellaoui (Celta Vigo) was the quickest one to orientate himself inside the box and leaps to connect with a cross from the corner kick. He produces a fine header, but it flies narrowly wide of the left post.
62' Hugo Sotelo (Celta Vigo) is about to take a corner kick.
62' Alex Remiro (Real Sociedad) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
61' Alex Remiro (Real Sociedad) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
61' Celta Vigo are ruled offside.
60' Alvaro Odriozola (Real Sociedad) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
59' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) and Borja Iglesias attempt to exchange short two-yard passes, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
57' Carl Starfelt (Celta Vigo) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Javier Alberola blows his whistle for a foul.
56' Claudio Giraldez prepares a substitution. Ilaix Moriba is replaced by Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo).
56' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Pablo Duran walks off the pitch to be replaced by Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo).
54' Alex Remiro leaps to collect the ball from the corner which was sent over by Hugo Sotelo (Celta Vigo).
54' Pablo Duran (Celta Vigo) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked. Celta Vigo win a corner.
54' The free kick from long range, taken by Real Sociedad, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
52' Hugo Alvarez (Celta Vigo) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee immediately stops play.
51' Great teamplay by Real Sociedad as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
50' Javier Alberola blows his whistle. Ilaix Moriba (Celta Vigo) commits a foul after dangerous play.
46' Pellegrino Matarazzo has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Alvaro Odriozola comes on the pitch for Benat Turrientes (Real Sociedad).
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) is replaced by Igor Zubeldia.
46' The game is over for Manuel Fernandez. Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) comes on for the second half.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+4' Javier Alberola blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+3' Bryan Zaragoza (Celta Vigo) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Javier Alberola didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
45+2' The ref signals that VAR has overturned that yellow card and upgraded it to a straight red for Duje Caleta-Car (Real Sociedad). He’s got to go!

45+1' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Duje Caleta-Car (Real Sociedad), but referee Javier Alberola must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
45' Duje Caleta-Car (Real Sociedad) will miss the next game because of that yellow card.
45' Duje Caleta-Car (Real Sociedad) is very lucky to stay on the pitch after using excessive force to bring down his opponent with a two-footed challenge.
42' Celta Vigo take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
42' The ball is cleared after Pablo Duran (Celta Vigo) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
40' Celta Vigo can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
37' Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
35' Fantastic run and shot from mid-range by Jones El Abdellaoui (Celta Vigo), but a defender denies him an almost certain goal by getting his body in the way.
32' Aihen Munoz (Real Sociedad) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it.
28' Bryan Zaragoza (Celta Vigo) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
27' A nice individual effort by Bryan Zaragoza (Celta Vigo) comes to nothing as his shot is blocked on the edge of the box by a defender. Now Celta Vigo have a corner.
25' Bryan Zaragoza (Celta Vigo) manages to beat his opponent to the ball, but he commits a foul in the process.
24' Celta Vigo take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
24' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 3:1.
21' Jon Gorrotxategi (Real Sociedad) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
19' Javier Alberola interrupts the game. One of the players from Celta Vigo won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.
17' 1 - 0 Goal - 1:0! Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) gets a shot away from the edge of the box and scores into the bottom right corner. Benat Turrientes provided an assist for the goal.
16' It must be a yellow card. It is. Luka Sucic (Real Sociedad) receives the caution after an awful tackle.
15' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Real Sociedad was in an offside position.
14' Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) jumps into a tackle and Javier Alberola signals a foul.
12' Neat passing move from Celta Vigo in order to create new attacking opportunities.
9' Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his header wasn't accurate at all and the ball went well over the bar.
9' The resulting set piece from Real Sociedad is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

8' Goncalo Guedes (Real Sociedad) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away. The ball is out of play and Real Sociedad manage to earn a corner.
6' Jon Aramburu (Real Sociedad) is unable to feed a through ball into the path of his teammates.
4' The Real Sociedad players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
3' Hugo Alvarez (Celta Vigo) serves up a nice cross, but Alex Remiro punches the ball away.
1' The corner from Bryan Zaragoza (Celta Vigo) is hurriedly cleared.

1' Bryan Zaragoza (Celta Vigo) is the first to arrive to a rebound inside the penalty area and unleashes a quick strike towards the left side of the target that beats the keeper. One of the defenders, however, makes a goal-line clearance.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Real Sociedad will kick the game off.
Javier Alberola got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
Show lineups Before the start of the game, you can see the starting lineups for today's clash.
